extraction_notes: The supplied ordering code is IRF530NPBF; the datasheet title prints IRF530NPbF, identifying the same lead-free PbF variant.
Electrical characteristics are headed TJ = 25 degC unless otherwise specified. The RDS(on) row is a maximum of 90 mOhm at VGS = 10 V and ID = 9.0 A; no typical RDS(on) table value is published.

Curve points are digitized reads from visible plotted traces at axis or grid locations; no interpolated points are included. The 25 degC traces were retained for transfer, output, capacitance, and body-diode semantics; corresponding 175 degC traces were not used.
The capacitance table is typical at VGS = 0 V, VDS = 25 V, and f = 1 MHz. Figure 5 defines Ciss = Cgs + Cgd with Cds shorted, Crss = Cgd, and Coss = Cds + Cgd.
The PDF identifies the original manufacturer as International Rectifier; the requested manufacturer field is preserved as Infineon Technologies.
Qg, Qgs, Qgd, thermal resistance, leakage, avalanche, and temperature-normalized RDS(on) data are present in the datasheet but have no dedicated fields in the strict extraction schema.
